title: Close Positions, Close Values

concept.title: Buckets whose width is the allowed difference plus one
body: You need two elements whose positions differ by at most `k` and whose values differ by at most `t`. Checking all pairs in the window costs a lot. Use **buckets**: put the value `x` into the bucket number `floor(x / (t + 1))`. All values of one bucket differ by at most `t`, so **two values in the same bucket always make a good pair**. Values in neighbouring buckets may or may not be close: compare them. Values in buckets that are further apart are always more than `t` apart.

body.code:
w = t + 1
for i, x in enumerate(a):
    b = x // w                       # floor division, also for negative x
    if b in buckets: found
    if b - 1 in buckets and x - buckets[b - 1] <= t: found
    if b + 1 in buckets and buckets[b + 1] - x <= t: found
    buckets[b] = x
    if i >= k: del buckets[a[i - k] // w]    # the window keeps the last k elements

body: Because two values in one bucket end the search, every bucket holds at most one value while the search goes on, so a plain map from bucket to value is enough. Use **floor** division: for negative numbers a plain `/` in C++ or Java rounds towards zero and would mix up the buckets.

statement: Given `n` integers and two numbers `k` and `t`, is there a pair of positions `i < j` with `j - i <= k` and `|a[i] - a[j]| <= t`? Print `yes` or `no`.

examples.note: The two 1s are 3 positions apart and their values differ by 0.
Values within 2 positions differ by 4 or more, and equal values are 3 positions apart: no pair.

hints: Use buckets of width `t + 1`: two values in one bucket are always close enough.
Also compare with the values in the two neighbouring buckets.
Remove the bucket of the element that leaves the window of size k, and use floor division for negative values.

a = list(map(int, input().split()))

explanation: Values are put into buckets of width `t + 1`; a bucket collision or a close value in a neighbouring bucket proves a pair, and the bucket of the element that leaves the window is removed.
solution.complexity: Time O(n) on average, space O(k).

code.python:
import sys
input = sys.stdin.readline

n, k, t = map(int, input().split())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))

w = t + 1
buckets = {}
found = False
for i, x in enumerate(a):
    b = x // w
    if b in buckets:
        found = True
        break
    if b - 1 in buckets and x - buckets[b - 1] <= t:
        found = True
        break
    if b + 1 in buckets and buckets[b + 1] - x <= t:
        found = True
        break
    buckets[b] = x
    if i >= k:
        del buckets[a[i - k] // w]
print("yes" if found else "no")
